I concede the strong balance sheet and free cash flow generation. This provides some buffer, but it does not insulate the stock from macro-driven multiple contraction or a slowdown in demand.

The arguments from other lenses, particularly those focused on short-term price movements or market sentiment, do not alter my assessment of the business's intrinsic worth.
